headline: 2 arrested after teacher killed in snatching attempt near Parliament
summary: Police have detained two suspects in connection with the death of Ronjila Parveen, but discrepancies in the recovered motorcycle's color raise questions.
details: A teacher from Bogura, Ronjila Parveen, was killed during a snatching attempt near the National Parliament area in Dhaka.
Her body was returned to her school in an ambulance, leaving students and family members in deep grief.
Police have arrested two suspects and recovered a motorcycle believed to be used in the crime.
However, questions have emerged regarding the color of the recovered motorcycle compared to the one seen in CCTV footage of the incident.
The investigation is ongoing as authorities work to determine if the suspects are the actual perpetrators or if other individuals were involved.
caption:
A teacher's life was cut short in a brutal snatching attempt near the Parliament. Now, questions arise over the evidence.

A teacher from Bogura, Ronjila Parveen, was killed during a snatching attempt near the National Parliament area in Dhaka.

Her body was returned to her school in an ambulance, leaving students and family members in deep grief.

Police have arrested two suspects and recovered a motorcycle believed to be used in the crime.

However, questions have emerged regarding the color of the recovered motorcycle compared to the one seen in CCTV footage of the incident.

The investigation is ongoing as authorities work to determine if the suspects are the actual perpetrators or if other individuals were involved.

Source: Dhaka Tribune, Prothom Alo
